Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells

Benefit: While you have an enhancing spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can conjure a floating force shield as a standard action, providing a shield bonus to AC equal to the highest-level enhancing spell you can cast. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting enhancing spells.
